SELECT i, i + 1 AS next, s FROM base WHERE i > 2 ORDER BY i DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5 OFFSET 1
SELECT i % 3 AS k, count(*) AS c, sum(i) FILTER (WHERE i > 1) AS f, string_agg(s, ',' ORDER BY i) AS a FROM base GROUP BY ALL HAVING count(*) > 0 ORDER BY 1
SELECT DISTINCT ON (i % 2) i, s FROM base ORDER BY i % 2, i
SELECT DISTINCT i % 2 AS m FROM base ORDER BY m
SELECT CASE WHEN i < 2 THEN 'low' WHEN i < 4 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'high' END AS c, CASE i WHEN 1 THEN 10 END AS d FROM base ORDER BY i
SELECT CAST(i AS BIGINT) AS a, TRY_CAST(s AS INTEGER) AS b, i::DECIMAL(9,2) AS c FROM base ORDER BY i
SELECT i BETWEEN 2 AND 3 AS a, i NOT BETWEEN 2 AND 3 AS b, i IN (1, 2) AS c, i NOT IN (1, 2) AS d, s IS NULL AS e, s IS NOT NULL AS f, NOT i = 1 AS g FROM base ORDER BY i
SELECT i = 1 OR i = 2 AND s <> 'x' AS a, i IS DISTINCT FROM 1 AS b, i IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 1 AS c, coalesce(s, 'none') AS d, nullif(i, 1) AS e FROM base ORDER BY i
SELECT s LIKE 'r%' AS a, s NOT LIKE 'r%' AS b, s ILIKE 'R%' AS c, s || '!' AS d, -i AS e, 1.5 AS f, 'it''s' AS g, NULL AS h, true AS j, 100000000000 AS k FROM base ORDER BY i
SELECT i, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY i) AS a, sum(i) OVER (PARTITION BY i % 2 ORDER BY i ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS b, lag(i, 2, 0) OVER (ORDER BY i) AS c FROM base ORDER BY i
SELECT i, first_value(i) OVER w AS a, last_value(i) OVER w AS b FROM base WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY i ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) ORDER BY i
SELECT i FROM base QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY i % 2 ORDER BY i) = 1 ORDER BY i
SELECT a.i, b.s FROM base a JOIN base b ON a.i = b.i + 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT a.i, b.i AS j FROM base a LEFT JOIN base b USING (i) ORDER BY 1
SELECT count(*) AS c FROM base a CROSS JOIN base b
SELECT * FROM base a NATURAL JOIN other ORDER BY i
SELECT a.i, b.i AS j FROM base a, base b WHERE a.i = b.i ORDER BY 1
SELECT i FROM base WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM other WHERE other.i = base.i) ORDER BY i
SELECT i FROM base WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM other WHERE other.i = base.i) ORDER BY i
SELECT i, (SELECT max(i) FROM other) AS m FROM base WHERE i IN (SELECT i FROM other) ORDER BY i
SELECT i FROM base WHERE i > ANY (SELECT i FROM other) ORDER BY i
SELECT i FROM base UNION ALL SELECT i FROM other ORDER BY 1
SELECT i FROM base UNION SELECT i FROM other UNION SELECT 100 ORDER BY 1
SELECT i FROM base EXCEPT SELECT i FROM other ORDER BY 1
SELECT i FROM base INTERSECT SELECT i FROM other ORDER BY 1
SELECT i FROM base UNION ALL BY NAME SELECT i FROM other ORDER BY 1
WITH c AS (SELECT i FROM base), d (x) AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT i + 1 FROM c) SELECT * FROM d ORDER BY 1
WITH RECURSIVE n (x) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT x + 1 FROM n WHERE x < 4) SELECT x FROM n ORDER BY x
SELECT * EXCLUDE (s) FROM base ORDER BY i
SELECT * REPLACE (i + 1 AS i) FROM base ORDER BY i
SELECT base.* FROM base ORDER BY i
SELECT COLUMNS('^i$') FROM base ORDER BY 1
SELECT * FROM (VALUES (1, 'a'), (2, 'b')) t (x, y) ORDER BY x
SELECT * FROM range(3) r (x) ORDER BY x
SELECT * FROM (SELECT i AS x FROM base) sub WHERE x > 1 ORDER BY x
SELECT [1, 2, 3] AS a, [1, 2, 3][2] AS b, [1, 2, 3][1:2] AS c, {'x': 1, 'y': 'z'} AS d, {'x': 1}.x AS e, MAP {'k': 1} AS f FROM base LIMIT 1
SELECT list_transform([1, 2], x -> x + 1) AS a, list_filter([1, 2, 3], lambda x: x > 1) AS b FROM base LIMIT 1
SELECT DATE '2020-01-02' AS a, TIMESTAMP '2020-01-02 03:04:05' AS b, INTERVAL 1 DAY AS c, 1e3 AS e FROM base LIMIT 1
SELECT i % 2 AS k, count(*) AS c FROM base GROUP BY ROLLUP (i % 2) ORDER BY 1 NULLS FIRST
SELECT i % 2 AS k, s, GROUPING(s) AS g FROM base GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((i % 2), (s)) ORDER BY 1, 2, 3
SELECT twice(i) AS a, add_default(i) AS b, add_default(i, b := 5) AS c FROM base ORDER BY i
SELECT * FROM evens() ORDER BY 1
SELECT 'b'::mood AS m, i FROM base ORDER BY i
SELECT i, doubled, label FROM with_everything ORDER BY i
SELECT * FROM other_schema.t ORDER BY 1
SELECT * FROM parent ORDER BY id
SELECT * FROM child ORDER BY id
SELECT * FROM compound ORDER BY 1, 2
SELECT * FROM indexed ORDER BY 1, 2
SELECT * FROM other_schema.keyed ORDER BY 1
